title: Nicole
creator: CrossFit
description: As many rounds as possible in 20 minutes of a 400 m run and a max set of pull-ups. Named after Nicole Carroll; each round you run, then hang on the bar until you drop, and the score is total pull-ups plus rounds. Scale with a shorter run or jumping pull-ups.

source.title: Nicole – CrossFit benchmark WOD ("The Girls")
source.author: CrossFit
source.license: Public benchmark; description in our own words

steps.note: Max reps: one set until you drop off the bar; score = total pull-ups
